caption: Onboarding builds the Monday slots for you: 10:00 AM onward in 30 minute steps with one click on Generate time slots. The banner says the app is free on development stores. The store name is hidden.
The plan screen sells Starter at $4.99 and Growth at $9.99 a month, with $19.99 struck through on Growth. Both are 50% promotion prices that end on 30 November. The store name is hidden.

Shopify's approval screen for Starter: $9.99 minus 50%, so $5.00 every 30 days after a 14 day trial ending 1 Dec, plus any taxes. Approve is greyed out next to an Add payment method row. We cancelled. The store name is hidden.
About 3 minutes after the install click our first service was listed as Active, linked to an Appointment product. The store name is hidden.
Inside the service, Slot configuration keeps the Minute / Hour booking type and the Monday slots from onboarding, so nothing had to be entered twice. The store name is hidden.
